title: IPEX INT4 Symmetric Weight Dequantization Unpack
prompt: Implement a Python function `dequantize_int4_symmetric(packed_weights: np.ndarray, scales: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray` that unpacks 4-bit integer weights packed two per uint8 byte. Follow symmetric quantization with zero-point offset 8: low nibble (bits 0-3) unpacked first, followed by high nibble (bits 4-7), converted to float32 as `(nibble - 8) * scale`.
target_invariant: Correct nibble order: W0 = byte & 0x0F, W1 = (byte >> 4) & 0x0F, dequant = (W - 8) * scale.
